items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Roger Johnson got a heart attack in the Dukes, and I saved the night. I played drums with the Dukes of Dixieland

ctx.x: So one night, he says, anybody that can catch these GD sticks when I throw them up in the air can have my set of drums. When he threw them up in the air, I caught both of them, and I played drums from that time on because I was born to keep time with music. Don't you see? Keep the beat. And one night, Roger Johnson got a heart attack in the Dukes, and I saved the night. I played drums with the Dukes of Dixieland, with their original Dukes, you know, their Santo boys.
That's incredible. It came right back to you, enough to keep the beat going?

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Little Chink Martin, Roger Johnson, Arthur Selig Jr. I just understand that he just lost his job, you know. He was night manager for the Bourbon Orleans Hotel.
